skill.name: cold-email
skill.description: Writes cold emails and follow-ups for people in a BeReach list: finds work emails, one sequence per persona, drafts the user sends. Use for any cold email or email outreach.
skill.summary: Prepare persona-based cold email sequences, verified address lookups, and reviewed drafts for the user to send.
skill.author: bereach-ai

content.value_statement: Cold outreach needs relevant contacts, credible personalization, and careful review. This skill guides BeReach list selection, address lookup, and persona-based email drafts for user approval.
actual_capabilities: Group BeReach contacts by persona and exclude do-not-contact, previously processed, or out-of-scope people.
Request approval before paid email lookups and accept only addresses marked verified.
Draft three- or four-email persona sequences with short subjects, factual personalization, and one offer.
Provide sending checks, country-specific footer guidance, draft review pages, and copy blocks with CSV handover.
Record outreach tags and do-not-contact status through BeReach contact tools.
Summarize user-provided replies, bounces, opt-outs, and batch results without estimating missing counts.
limitations: Does not send emails, read a mailbox, or run follow-up delivery; the user manages those actions.
Requires connected BeReach tools for contact operations; address lookup and enrichment can consume credits.
Relies on saved persona and voice cards, with companion skills needed when those records are missing.
Does not guarantee deliverability, reply rates, or legal compliance; country rules require independent verification.

use_cases.title: Prepare a first outreach batch
use_cases.description: Review sending readiness and draft a short sequence for a small, relevant BeReach contact list.

use_cases.title: Coordinate persona-based prospecting
use_cases.description: Separate sales prospects by persona, approve lookup costs, and review personalized drafts before manual sending.

use_cases.title: Compare outreach results
use_cases.description: Review mature batch results from supplied counts and select one message change for the next test.

prompt_templates.title: Check sending readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my sending setup: [mailbox], [authentication status], [daily volume], [recipient countries], and [tracking settings]. List issues without looking up addresses.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: assess readiness before preparing outreach.

prompt_templates.title: Draft one persona sequence
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a four-email sequence for [persona] using [offer] and my saved voice card. Use only supplied facts and include appropriate opt-out wording.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: review message templates before contact-level personalization.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a reviewed contact batch
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare campaign [campaignId] in batches of at most 25. Show persona assignments and estimated costs before spending credits. Request approval before lookup and handover.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: coordinate contact selection, verified address lookup, and draft review.

prompt_templates.title: Design the next batch test
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze these dated batch counts by persona: [counts]. Exclude immature batches and rates below ten sent. Compare passing versions and propose one change.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: evaluate user-supplied results without open-rate assumptions.

output_examples.input: Review a persona batch sent 12 days ago: 20 sent, four replies, two interested, no bounces, and one opt-out.
output: Results: 20 sent, four replies, two interested replies, no bounces, and one opt-out.
The batch is old enough to report rates and exceeds the ten-sent minimum.
Next test proposal: change only the subject within this persona; keep the offer and body unchanged.

best_practices: Confirm recipient eligibility, suppression status, country rules, and lookup costs before approving paid work.
Use sourced, dated facts and a deliverable offer; review every personalized draft before handover.
Send from your own mailbox with tracking off, honor objections immediately, and report actual batch counts.
anti_patterns: Sending to guessed addresses, unverified contacts, or people who requested no further contact.
Inventing personalization, customer results, reply counts, or evidence for an offer.
Treating draft handover as automatic delivery or using LinkedIn messaging tools to send email.

faq.question: Does this skill send emails?
faq.answer: No. It prepares drafts and handover material. You send emails from your own mailbox or email tool.

faq.question: What does the workflow require?
faq.answer: Contact operations require connected BeReach tools and a contact list. Missing persona or voice cards require the related companion skills.

faq.question: Can address lookup consume credits?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow requests approval before spending. Email lookup costs one credit per found address; unsuccessful lookups are free.

faq.question: How does it handle missing personalization?
faq.answer: It uses a persona-relevant situation when no usable recent fact exists. It prohibits invented facts and unsupported customer claims.

faq.question: Does it guarantee legal compliance?
faq.answer: No. It provides country-specific guidance, not legal advice. Verify current rules and seek legal advice when recipient eligibility is uncertain.

faq.question: How are opt-outs and results handled?
faq.answer: It records do-not-contact status; you stop running sequences. Results use your supplied counts, with no rates below ten sent or before seven days.
